headerDisplay: A virtual light that turns on for a short time at a fixed interval. Use it as a trigger for HomeKit automations.

intervalSeconds.title: Interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: Time between pulses. Decimals are allowed (e.g. 2.5).

onSeconds.title: ON time (seconds)
onSeconds.description: How long the light stays on for each pulse. Must be shorter than the interval. Decimals are allowed (e.g. 0.5).
